validation.summary: The candidate implementation is excellent. It accurately reproduces the complex scroll-driven animations, sticky sections, and interactive navigation menus from the reference video. The GSAP logic is well-structured and the centralized CONFIG object makes the template highly editable.
strengths: Perfect implementation of the Problem/Solution SVG line drawing and converging animation.
Accurate scroll-spy highlighting in the Clinical Support section.
Smooth and responsive mega menu and dropdown interactions.
Clean, modular React component structure with proper GSAP cleanup.
